主导系统架构、算法训练与真机部署，构建从来球感知到全身击球控制的闭环系统，实现单: Led architecture, policy training, and real-robot deployment, building a closed loop from incoming-ball perception to whole-body striking control. The longest continuous rally reached 200+ returns.
将来球预测与运动控制通过击球命令解耦：上层给出击球时间、位置和期望球拍速度，下层: Ball prediction and motion control are decoupled through striking commands: the upper layer specifies contact time, position, and desired racket velocity; the lower-level policy combines these commands with proprioception to move and swing.

面向正手、反手与待机三类命令，训练统一的全身控制策略，使机器人移动到合适击球位置: A unified whole-body policy handles forehand, backhand, and standby commands, moves to the striking position, swings at the specified time and velocity, and returns to a ready stance.
将正反手参考动作重定向到机器人，分别使用 AMP 判别器学习动作风格；按任务状态: Forehand and backhand references are retargeted to the robot, with separate AMP discriminators learning each style. Task-dependent activation of style rewards reduces interference between motion priors.
多锚点引导：以双足与骨盆共同引导机体移动，兼顾站位与姿态稳定。: Multi-anchor guidance: uses both feet and the pelvis to guide motion while balancing positioning and posture stability.
稀疏击球奖励：结合击球轴线、时间窗口和自适应奖励尺度，引导球拍同时满足位置、速度: Sparse striking rewards: combines the strike axis, timing windows, and adaptive reward scales to meet racket position, velocity, and orientation targets.
实机迁移：随机化摩擦、质量、质心和执行器增益，加入外部扰动与异常终止条件。: Sim-to-real: randomizes friction, mass, center of mass, and actuator gains, with external disturbances and termination conditions.
Actor 使用角速度、重力投影、关节状态、上一时刻动作和击球命令等实机可用信息: The actor uses deployable observations such as angular velocity, projected gravity, joint states, previous actions, and striking commands. The critic additionally receives privileged racket position, velocity, and orientation errors during training.
策略输出 G1 的 29 自由度动作。训练中交替采样击球与待机命令，并为正反手分: The policy produces 29-DoF actions for G1. Alternating strike and standby commands, with forehand/backhand target-position offsets, connect striking, locomotion, and recovery.
从动捕位置序列恢复球的运动状态，通过辨识后的飞行与碰撞模型预测未来轨迹，再将可击: Estimates ball motion from tracked positions, predicts trajectories with identified flight and collision models, and converts reachable contact points into whole-body control commands.
动态缓存带时间戳的三维位置，分别对 x、y、z 方向进行最小二乘拟合，估计当前位: Caches timestamped 3D positions and fits each coordinate with least squares to estimate position and velocity. The cache is reset after a table bounce to avoid fitting across velocity discontinuities.
飞行阶段考虑重力与速度相关的空气阻力，桌面碰撞阶段分别建模水平、垂直速度的恢复关: Models gravity and velocity-dependent drag during flight, and separate horizontal and vertical velocity restitution at table contact. Forward Euler integration advances position and velocity, switching to the collision model at each bounce.
利用实测轨迹中的速度和加速度估计空气阻力系数；对比弹跳前后的水平、垂直速度，辨识: Estimates drag from measured velocities and accelerations, and identifies horizontal and vertical restitution from pre- and post-bounce velocities to match the ball and contact conditions.
当预测轨迹进入预设击球区域时，确定击球时间和位置；结合期望落点与飞行时间计算出球: When the predicted ball enters the reachable striking region, the system selects contact time and position. A desired landing point and flight time determine outgoing velocity; a simplified collision relation yields the desired racket velocity for the whole-body policy.
利用历史 15 帧观测预测未来轨迹，并与实测轨迹对照，检验状态估计、参数辨识和轨: Uses the previous 15 observations to predict future motion and compares predictions with measured trajectories, evaluating the integrated estimation, identification, and prediction pipeline.

作为“星星之火”团队队长，带队参加高速自动驾驶仿真算法赛。方案结合 Catego: Led the Xingxing Zhihuo team in a highway-driving simulation competition. The approach combines Categorical PPO, dynamic reward guidance, and PD control for obstacle avoidance, overtaking, lane changes, and improved stability after lane changes.

Categorical PPO：将加速度与转向角分别离散为 11 个取值，组成: Categorical PPO: discretizes acceleration and steering into 11 values each, yielding 121 joint actions. Uses GAE, value and advantage normalization, and early stopping when policy-update KL divergence becomes too large.

动态奖励引导：先学习避障与到达目标，再逐步提高规则项奖励权重，引导策略学习更稳定: Dynamic reward guidance: first learns obstacle avoidance and goal reaching, then gradually increases traffic-rule reward weights to encourage more stable driving.
